title: Figure 13. Hypersonic Flow Past a Sphere (bow shock schematic)
description: Line schematic of a sphere in hypersonic flow showing a curved bow shock ahead of it, with labels "Turbulent Wake," "Expansion Fans," "Bow Shock," shock angle β, flow regions numbered 1 and 2, and freestream "M1 = 5.0" indicated by an arrow. Captioned "Figure 13. Hypersonic Flow Past a Sphere." The accompanying text discusses estimating the speed of a sphere from the peak wavelength of its emitted infrared radiation.
